# MyPdfTools — Complete Guide & Documentation (llms-full.txt)

> MyPdfTools is a 100% private, free, and in-browser PDF suite operating on https://www.mypdftools.it and https://www.mypdftools.de. Zero files are uploaded to external servers. All processing is executed strictly on the client's device memory.

## Architecture & Privacy Guarantee

MyPdfTools runs entirely client-side using JavaScript, WebAssembly, and Mozilla PDF.js workers. When a user opens any tool:
- Files are loaded via FileReader API into local browser memory.
- PDF manipulation and rendering are executed via pdf-lib and pdfjs-dist within the user's browser.
- Converted outputs (such as images, merged PDFs, or ZIP archives) are generated in-memory and downloaded directly via Blob URLs.
- No network requests containing document payload are ever dispatched.

## Available PDF Tools

### Merge PDF
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/merge-pdf
- Description: Combine multiple PDF files in any selected order into one PDF.
- Features: Drag-and-drop file reordering, file size display, instantaneous in-browser merging.

### Split PDF
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/split-pdf
- Description: Split single pages or custom page ranges into independent PDF files.
- Features: Range selection (e.g. 1-3, 5), individual page extraction.

### Compress PDF
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/compress-pdf
- Description: Optimize and compress PDF documents to reduce file size.
- Features: Client-side stream optimization, image downscaling, quality preservation.

### PDF to JPG
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/pdf-to-jpg
- Description: Convert PDF document pages into high-resolution JPG images.
- Features: Multi-page rendering, instant single-image download, one-click ZIP archive packaging.

### JPG to PDF
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/jpg-to-pdf
- Description: Convert images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a formatted PDF document.
- Features: Orientation selection (Portrait/Landscape), margin controls, custom page sizing.

### Rotate PDF
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/rotate-pdf
- Description: Rotate pages of a PDF document by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- Features: Rotate all pages or selected individual pages.

### Organize PDF
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/organize-pdf
- Description: Reorder, delete, and duplicate PDF pages visually.
- Features: Interactive page thumbnail grid, intuitive rearrangement.

### Protect PDF
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/protect-pdf
- Description: Encrypt PDF files with 128-bit / 256-bit AES password protection.
- Features: Strong client-side encryption.

### Unlock PDF
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/unlock-pdf
- Description: Remove password security from password-protected PDF files when known.

### Sign PDF
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/sign-pdf
- Description: Add drawn or typed electronic signatures and date stamps to PDF pages.

### Watermark PDF
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/watermark
- Description: Overlay custom text or image watermarks with adjustable position and opacity.

### Page Numbers
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/page-numbers
- Description: Add pagination numbers to top or bottom corners of PDF documents.

### PDF to Markdown
- URL: https://www.mypdftools.it/#/pdf-to-markdown
- Description: Extract text formatting, headers, and tables from PDFs into structured Markdown.

## Domain Mapping

- https://www.mypdftools.it : Primary production portal serving Italian users.
- https://www.mypdftools.de : Primary production portal serving German users.
